name: KPJ
recent: KPJ Healthcare 近期公告以主要股东（EPF、KWAP、Johor Corporation 等）的持股变动申报为主，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，公司获评为东盟医疗品牌强度第一、品牌价值第二，并完成东南亚首例机器人辅助心脏手术。最新财报显示营收与净利同比、环比均增长。
notable: 获评为东盟医疗品牌强度第一、品牌价值第二（约3.05亿美元）。
完成东南亚首例机器人辅助心脏手术。
推出 Sound of Hope 计划，惠及五州4,500名学生。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为11.97亿令吉，净利1.04亿令吉，净利率8.7%；营收环比增长14.0%、同比增长16.9%，净利环比增长49.2%、同比增长26.6%，净利率高于上一季度的6.6%。

recent_en: KPJ Healthcare's recent announcements are mainly changes in substantial shareholders' interests (EPF, KWAP, Johor Corporation, etc.), with no major corporate activities. In the news, the company was ranked first in ASEAN for healthcare brand strength and second in brand value, and performed Southeast Asia's first robotic-assisted cardiac surgery. The latest financial results show revenue and net profit growing both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Ranked first in ASEAN for healthcare brand strength and second in brand value (about US$305 million).
Performed Southeast Asia's first robotic-assisted cardiac surgery.
Launched the Sound of Hope programme benefiting 4,500 students in five states.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1.197 billion and net profit was RM103.9 million, with a net margin of 8.7%; revenue grew 14.0% QoQ and 16.9% YoY, while net profit grew 49.2% QoQ and 26.6% YoY, with net margin higher than 6.6% in the previous quarter.
